breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant across two segments, rather than using a single uniform torque over the full shaft. It explicitly defines Segment 1 (0→750 mm) with an internal torque of 150,000 N·mm and Segment 2 (750→1500 mm) with an internal torque of 300,000 N·mm, which aligns with the ground truth approach of analyzing each segment independently based on the applied torques.
